title: Senior HCL Commerce
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


Our team is looking for a **Senior HCL Commerce** **professional** who has strong knowledge of commerce platform development and modern web technologies, and who can support B2B business needs while delivering applications successfully in an Agile environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop application components, including WCS storefront and business logic, Java/Spring Boot services, and Next.js / React storefront work as assigned
* Participate in gathering requirements, documenting, and designing HCL Commerce / WCS functionality and related enhancements
* Support application integration testing, integration development, data conversion, and cut\-over activities
* Design, develop, and implement multi\-tier commerce applications to support B2B business requirements, including punchout and other customer purchasing\-system channels
* Create and review designs that identify reusability, performance issues, and best practices for Commerce, REST/SOAP services, and Java
* Support the full life cycle of storefront pages, store data, store business logic, customization of WebSphere / HCL Commerce tools, and integration with back\-end systems
* Implement Java\-based solutions for public\-facing B2B websites based on business requirements, and extend or consume Spring Boot APIs that wrap or replace Commerce capabilities
* Contribute to Next.js / React storefront work, including pages and data fetching, to keep migrated and unmigrated journeys consistent
* Perform unit testing before moving code/configuration to QA, and research defects to identify root causes across WCS, Spring Boot, and Next.js
* Identify key barriers and core problems, and apply problem\-solving skills to troubleshoot and resolve issues in a dual\-run architecture

**Requirements**

* 5\-10 years of overall IT experience is required
* 5\+ years of expertise in HCL Commerce and/or IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) 8\.x is needed, covering store customization, business logic, tools, catalog/order/user flows, and integration with back\-end systems
* 5\+ years of Java development and OOD skills on large IT systems are required, with J2EE on WebSphere Application Server strongly preferred
* 3\+ years of experience in Spring, Spring MVC, and hands\-on Spring Boot, including REST APIs and service integration, is needed
* 5\+ years of experience in web services, including REST and SOAP, is required
* 5\+ years of experience in source control is required, with Git mandatory and SVN/CVS acceptable as prior experience
* 3\+ years of experience in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS is required, along with mandatory experience in Next.js and React; TypeScript is preferred
* Experience with Agile delivery using Atlassian tools, including Jira, Bitbucket/Git, and Confluence, is expected
* Strong communication skills and proven team player capability are essential

**Nice to have**

* Background in B2B commerce, punchout, and/or mobile commerce business models
* Familiarity with headless or composable commerce patterns, including API\-first storefronts that consume Commerce or BFF/microservices; MuleSoft or similar iPaaS experience is a plus
* Knowledge of additional JS frameworks, such as Angular or Vue, as secondary experience
* Exposure to search (Solr), session/page cache (Redis or similar), and CMS\-driven storefronts such as Optimizely or equivalent alongside a commerce engine
* Understanding that Preview and Runtime Commerce stacks are distinct environments rather than identical ones

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Founding Backend Engineer — Node.js + Go (Payments)
description:
Founding Backend Engineer — Node.js \+ Go (Payments)

**Location:** Manesar, Haryana, in person  
**Employment:** Full\-time

About Wnted

Wnted is building a save\-now\-buy\-later platform that helps people fund the things they want before purchasing them, without taking on BNPL debt.

Users can save toward any product, automate contributions, track prices and availability, and redeem their funds when they are ready to buy. Underneath that simple experience is a serious financial backend involving money movement, recurring transfers, webhooks, reconciliation, rewards, gift\-card fulfillment, and financial records that must remain correct under concurrency and failure.

We are moving from private beta toward public scale and are hiring a senior, hands\-on backend engineer to become one of the technical owners of the company.

The Role

As a Founding Backend Engineer, you will own backend architecture and execution across both **Node.js/TypeScript and Go**. This is not a role where one language can be delegated to someone else.

You will work directly with the founders and early engineering team to build systems that are secure, observable, financially correct, and capable of scaling well beyond our traffic today.

You will be expected to make architecture decisions, write and review production code, operate what you build, and push back when a proposed shortcut creates unacceptable financial, security, or reliability risk.

What You Will Own

* Design, build, and operate services across Node.js, Express, TypeScript, and Go.
* Build financially correct flows for deposits, purchases, rewards, refunds, webhooks, and reconciliation.
* Establish clear idempotency, ledger, retry, and failure\-recovery patterns.
* Own PostgreSQL schema design, transactions, constraints, migrations, query performance, and concurrency behavior.
* Plan safe online migrations for live tables without unnecessary downtime.
* Improve our Docker builds, cloud deployments, logging, metrics, alerts, and incident response.
* Diagnose production issues from application logs, database behavior, infrastructure metrics, and Linux systems.
* Strengthen webhook verification, secrets management, replay protection, sensitive\-data logging rules, and defenses against issues such as SSRF.
* Review pull requests seriously and raise the engineering standard of the team.
* Use tools such as Sentry, CodeRabbit, and Copilot review as useful inputs—not as substitutes for engineering judgment.
* Write down important decisions and take on\-call responsibility for the systems you build.
* Work closely with the founders to balance shipping speed against financial and security risk.

What We NeedProduction experience in both Node.js and Go

You have built and operated real production systems using:

* Node.js, Express, and TypeScript
* Prisma or an equivalent ORM, including real schema migrations
* Go with frameworks or libraries such as Fiber, Gin, chi, pgx, or sqlc

Tutorial projects or surface\-level exposure to one of the two ecosystems will not be enough.

Strong PostgreSQL fundamentals

You can reason clearly about:

* Transactions and isolation levels
* Race conditions and concurrent writes
* Unique constraints as the final source of truth
* Safe migrations on hot tables
* Indexes and query plans
* Keyset pagination
* Raw SQL when an ORM is not the right tool

Real operational ownership

You have deployed and operated containerized services on GCP or AWS using systems such as Cloud Run, ECS, or Kubernetes.

You can own a Docker build, work comfortably on a Linux machine, investigate logs and metrics during an incident, and follow a problem through to resolution. You have not only written code that someone else deployed and operated.

Experience where correctness mattered

You have personally operated either:

* A system handling thousands of requests per second, or
* A money\-moving system where concurrency and correctness had real consequences

Be prepared to quantify the scale and explain a production incident you personally diagnosed and resolved.

Payments or financial\-systems thinking

You understand:

* Idempotency
* At\-least\-once webhook delivery
* Unknown payment states
* Reconciliation
* Ledger or double\-entry thinking
* Safe retries
* Integer or decimal representations for money

Direct experience with Stripe, Braintree, ACH, card processing, banking infrastructure, or another PSP is strongly preferred.

Security instinct

You have implemented controls such as HMAC verification, replay protection, secure secret handling, and sensitive\-data logging restrictions. You understand SSRF and related backend risks, and you have personally fixed security vulnerabilities in production.

Product\-startup experience

You have spent at least two to three years inside a product startup, owning systems beyond initial delivery. You can make an architecture decision end to end, explain its tradeoffs, and challenge founders or teammates when necessary.

Agency or consulting experience can be relevant, but only if it included continued production ownership after handoff.

Nice to Have

* Redis, queues, or Google Cloud Tasks
* Fastify
* Recommendation systems, embeddings, or pgvector
* Expo push notifications or production email pipelines
* Scraping and anti\-bot experience
* KYC or AML exposure
* Prometheus and Grafana
* PCI\-related experience

What Will Not Work in This Role

This role is unlikely to be a fit if:

* You use floating\-point values for money.
* You rely entirely on an ORM and cannot write or analyze SQL.
* You have never personally deployed or operated your work.
* Your experience ends when a client project is handed over.
* You cannot describe a meaningful production incident you personally resolved.
* You want to work exclusively in either Node.js or Go.
* You do not want ownership of production support and on\-call responsibilities.

How We Interview

Our interview process focuses on real production judgment rather than trivia:

* Founder conversation and initial technical screening
* Deep dive into a system and production incident you personally owned
* Backend architecture, payments, PostgreSQL, security, and concurrency discussion
* Practical code or system\-review exercise
* In\-person working session with the team

We will ask you to reason through ambiguous payment states, retries, database races, migrations, and incidents. We care as much about the questions you ask as the solution you propose.

Why Join Wnted

* Become an early technical owner, not a ticket taker.
* Build financial infrastructure whose correctness directly affects customers.
* Influence architecture, engineering practices, security, and hiring from the beginning.
* Work directly with the founders in person.
* Receive meaningful equity and help shape a product before public scale.

To apply, send your résumé or LinkedIn profile, GitHub or technical work if available, and a short note describing:

* A Node.js/TypeScript system and a Go system you personally shipped
* The largest\-scale or highest\-stakes production system you operated
* A production incident you personally resolved
* Why you want to build Wnted

Pay: ₹336,373\.57 \- ₹1,631,850\.33 per year

Application Question(s):

* This is a full\-time, in\-person position in Manesar, Haryana. Are you willing and able to work from our Manesar office?
* Do you have at least two years of experience inside a product startup or product company, with responsibility for deployments, maintenance, production incidents, or on\-call support? (explain in 100 words)
* Describe the highest\-scale or highest\-stakes production system you personally operated.

Include the peak requests per second, daily transaction volume, or amount of money processed. Then describe one production incident you personally diagnosed and resolved: how it was detected, the root cause, the immediate fix, and what you changed to prevent it from happening again. (120 words max)

* Describe the most challenging migration you personally performed on a live PostgreSQL table.

Include the approximate table size and traffic, what schema or data change was required, the risk of blocking writes or causing downtime, how you rolled it out safely, and your rollback plan. (120 words max)

* Describe a payment, ledger, webhook, or reconciliation flow that you personally designed or operated.

Include:

The payment provider or banking system involved  
How idempotency was enforced  
How duplicate or delayed webhooks were handled  
How unknown or inconsistent payment states were reconciled  
One failure mode you encountered

* What is your current CTC?
* What is your expected CTC?
* How many days of notice period do you have? Is it negotiable?

Experience:

* Golang: 1 year (Required)
* Node.js: 1 year (Required)
* Payments Engineering: 1 year (Required)
* PostgreSQL: 1 year (Required)

title: Senior Principal IT Pillar Specialist
description:
**Job Overview:**

As a part of the Global Application Management and Support (GAMS) team, this individual will be responsible to manage the development and modernization of EDMS (iDocs) Platform technically. With this role we are looking to strengthen development and support team who will liaise with cross\-functional teams, to ensure successful delivery of support services at McDermott. The successful candidate will possess a strong technical background and also has a good understanding of business processes related to Document management. This role requires innovative/constructive thinking, in\-depth technical expertise, process knowledge, operational experience for a globally spread support team. The Development Lead provides hands\-on technical leadership for enterprise web applications built with Angular, Java and Python. The role owns solution design, engineering quality, secure delivery, release readiness and production reliability while coaching developers and partnering with Product, UX, Architecture, Security, DevOps, Data and Support teams. The Lead converts business priorities into scalable, maintainable solutions and ensures the team delivers with clear ownership, disciplined testing and measurable operational outcomes.


  
Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
  

  

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

* Lead end\-to\-end technical delivery from discovery and estimation through design, build, testing, deployment and support.

**Essential Qualifications and Education:**

* 10\+ years of enterprise software\-development experience, including business\-critical web applications.
* 3\+ years as a Development Lead, Technical Lead or comparable engineering leader.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Angular and TypeScript experience.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Java and Spring Boot experience.
* 2\+ years of practical Python development for APIs, services, integrations, automation or data processing.
* Demonstrated leadership of approximately five or more engineers through direct or matrix accountability.
* Strong experience with cloud platforms, CI/CD, microservices, REST APIs, databases and code\-review practices.
* Proven ownership of architecture decisions, secure delivery, production support and root\-cause resolution.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* 10\+ years of enterprise software development and 3\+ years of technical\-leadership experience.
* 5\+ years of Angular experience covering TypeScript, component architecture, routing, forms, responsive design, state management, performance and testing.
* 5\+ years of Java and Spring Boot experience covering REST APIs, dependency injection, persistence, exception handling and service design.
* 2\+ years of Python experience for APIs, services, integration, automation or data\-processing use cases.
* Experience leading or mentoring a team of approximately five or more developers.
* Strong knowledge of secure API and microservices design, validation, versioning, failure handling and distributed\-system fundamentals.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, data modeling and transaction management.
* Experience with Azure, AWS or OCI; Git workflows; CI/CD; automated deployment; and environment\-based configuration.
* Experience with unit, integration and end\-to\-end testing, quality gates, code scanning and security scanning.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot production issues across browser, API, application, database and integration layers.
* Strong estimation, planning, risk\-management, stakeholder and technical\-communication skills.
* Docker and Kubernetes or equivalent managed container platforms.
* Event\-driven architecture and messaging technologies such as Kafka.
* Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask or Django; JPA or Hibernate for Java persistence.
* OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, enterprise identity providers and role\-based access control.
* Web accessibility, internationalization, caching, content delivery and front\-end performance optimization.
* Application performance monitoring, centralized logging and distributed tracing.
* DevSecOps, threat modeling, OWASP awareness, software\-composition analysis and secrets management.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.  



  

**Introduction to team**

The Lodging connectivity Organization at Expedia Group is seeking an experienced backend developer and a seasoned technologist with a passion for building robust, scalable, and high\-performance applications that help millions of people plan their travels and create lifelong memories. Join us as we revolutionize the travel industry!  

  



The organization owns a core lever of Expedia Group's growth: expanding global lodging supply and making it a source of competitive advantage. We build and operate the platform that sources, normalizes, and serves third\-party lodging inventory — powering the shopping, booking, servicing, and claims journeys that travelers rely on every day. Through resilient API integrations and AI agentic workflows, we bring diverse partner content onto a single platform and make it competitive, accurate, and bookable at scale.


We are part of the partner connectivity platform that serves as the backbone of Expedia's business, powering an efficient two\-way marketplace that bridges supply and demand. Our platform sources properties and handles more than 3M transactions per minute. Built with modern technologies like Java, Kotlin, Spring, GraphQL, Kafka, DynamoDB, ML, Elasticsearch, and Redis on AWS, our ecosystem supports millions of travelers in finding the best travel products tailored to their needs.  

  



If you're passionate about creating transformative solutions, tackling large\-scale engineering challenges, and shaping the future of lodging supply, we'd love to have you on our team. Join us, and let's redefine the way the world travels together!  

  



**In this role, you will:**

* Design, build, and evolve scalable, reliable services and software components, including system design, low\-level design, API design, and data modeling to support customer\-facing and platform experiences.
* Lead the technical design across domains and delivery of complex, multi\-quarter initiatives across the 3PI supply system that support shopping, booking, servicing, and claims journeys.
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of complex features or services, from technical design through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement in production.
* Break down large, ambiguous business problems into clear technical solutions that can be reused across multiple domains and services, driving streamlined execution by the team.
* Write, review, and maintain high\-quality, well\-tested code while driving best practices in code quality, security, observability, resilience, and performance.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by reducing incidents, enhancing observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve traveler and business outcomes, applying AI\-driven systems, tools, and workflows to production\-grade software.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and architecture, and raising the overall engineering bar for the team.
* Partner with product, analytics, design, and engineering teams to apply data\-driven decision making, define success metrics, and improve system health and user outcomes over time.
* Contribute to architectural direction by participating in design reviews, proposing improvements, leading communities of practice, and helping shape long\-term technical strategy.
Technologies we use: Java, Kotlin, Spring, GraphQL, Docker, Kafka, DynamoDB, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Redis, Datadog, Splunk, and AWS cloud.  
* 

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 10\+ years of professional, post\-college backend software development experience in an object\-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end\-to\-end delivery for services or components — design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support — within a multi\-service or multi\-domain environment.
* Deep understanding of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures, with a strong command of core engineering practices including object\-oriented design, testing, and version control.
* Hands\-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable, maintainable systems.
* Hands\-on expertise with AI/ML frameworks and tools, and experience applying AI/ML concepts to real\-world products.
* Experience building on cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) with sound architectural patterns and scalable, cost\-efficient, production\-quality systems.
Strong communication skills and a highly effective collaborator — able to articulate ideas to teammates, peers, and leaders, support them with data, and incorporate others' feedback to find common ground.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing and evolving service and application architectures for high\-traffic, distributed systems, including clear API contracts, data models, and low\-level designs.
* Demonstrated track record driving technical direction for services or domains, making data\-informed tradeoffs across scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Experience with partner or third\-party integrations, supply/inventory systems, or high\-volume marketplace platforms.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, and continuous improvement of production systems and developer workflows.
* Experience leading cross\-team technical initiatives or migrations, influencing engineering best practices across a domain, and guiding teams on effective and responsible use of AI\-assisted development and testing tools.
* A self\-starter who embraces change and is always open to replacing what you built yesterday with something better today.

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .  



  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.  



  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .  



  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Engineer – Data Backend - Python
description:
**What the role is all about:**


We are looking for an Engineer with 2–3 years of experience to join the CXAD team within the Experiences \& Platforms portfolio. The team builds and operates data platforms and pipelines that enable teams across the business to better understand customer behaviour and deliver data\-driven experiences.


As part of the CXAD team, you will work with large\-scale customer and behavioural datasets and contribute to building reliable, scalable data pipelines and backend systems. The data and platforms we build support a wide range of use cases across the business, including analytics, machine learning, personalisation, recommendations, product insights, and reporting.


This is an opportunity to work on complex data engineering problems in a distributed team, collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, and build systems that have a direct impact on how our products understand and serve our customers.


While no two days are likely to be the same, your typical responsibilities will include:


* Develop, maintain, and enhance data pipelines using Python and SQL, ensuring they are reliable, scalable, and maintainable.
* Build and manage data workflows using technologies such as Airflow and other data engineering and orchestration platforms.
* Work with large\-scale customer and behavioural datasets to transform and prepare data for consumption by downstream teams.
* Collaborate with analytics, machine learning, recommendations, product, and other stakeholder teams to understand their data requirements and deliver fit\-for\-purpose solutions.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code following engineering best practices and coding standards.
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and team ceremonies, contributing to the continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices.
* Troubleshoot pipeline and production issues, identify root causes, and contribute to maintaining the reliability and operational stability of data platforms.
* Contribute to automation, tooling improvements, monitoring, and other initiatives that improve the reliability and efficiency of data pipelines.
* Learn and adopt new technologies and engineering practices while sharing knowledge and contributing to a collaborative team environment. Who we’re looking for:
* 2–3 years of experience working in backend, data engineering, or platform engineering environments.
* Strong programming skills in Python, with experience writing clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code
* Strong SQL skills and an understanding of relational and analytical data concepts.
* Hands\-on experience designing, developing, maintaining, or supporting data pipelines.
* Good understanding of software development principles, including version control, testing, debugging, and code reviews.
* Ability to understand and work with existing codebases, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to production systems.
* Understanding of data engineering concepts such as batch processing, ELT/ETL, data transformation, data quality, and data reliability.
* Ability to work collaboratively with engineers, data engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.
* Good communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
* Ability to work collaboratively and autonomously in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to learn new and complex technologies and contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Bonus points for:


* Experience working with cloud platforms, particularly AWS and/or GCP.
* Experience building and integrating APIs using Python or any other programming language.
* Knowledge or hands\-on experience with CI/CD practices and tools.
* Exposure to real\-time or streaming data pipelines and technologies such as Kafka.
* Exposure to workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow.
* Experience with Docker and containerised applications.
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
* Understanding of observability, monitoring, and operational practices for production systems.
* Experience working with open\-source technologies and tooling.

What we offer:


* A hybrid and flexible approach to working.
* Transport options to help you get to and from work, including home pick\-up and drop\-off.
* Meals provided on site in our office.
* Flexible leave options including parental leave, family care leave and celebration leave.
* Insurances for you and your immediate family members.
* Programs to support mental, emotional, financial and physical health \& wellbeing
* Continuous learning and development opportunities to further your technical expertise.

The values we live by:


Our values are at the core of how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. We believe that how we work is equally important as what we do to achieve our goals. This commitment is at the heart of everything we do, from the way we interact with colleagues to the way we serve our customers and communities.


Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We are committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion. We believe teams with diverse ideas and experiences are more creative, more effective and fuel disruptive thinking \- be it cultural and ethnic backgrounds, gender identity, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other identity or lived experience. We know diverse teams are critical to maintaining our success and driving new business opportunities. If you’ve got the skills, dedication and enthusiasm to learn but don’t necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.
